title: Webb County Firefighters Put Out Grass Fire Along Highway 359 Near Pueblo Nuevo
excerpt: Webb County firefighters put out a grass fire along Highway 359 near Pueblo Nuevo that burned about half a block and damaged an iron fence; crews saw no signs of foul play.
content:
Webb County firefighters put out a grass fire along Highway 359 near Pueblo Nuevo on Friday night.

The flames burned about half a block near the entrance to a private property and damaged an iron fence, the fire department said.

A firefighter at the scene said crews saw no signs of foul play.

The fire came while Webb County remains under a countywide burn ban in effect since Aug. 26, which prohibits outdoor burning.

Sources: Webb County Fire Department, Nov. 28, 2026; Texas A&M Forest Service burn ban data.
